authority: Abhishek Choudhary (AyeAI). Rulings here are canon; a model never edits this file's rules, only reports violations.
why_executable: A prose contract was already in this repo and was still missed: a push landed with no Candor receipt and a broken MANIFEST. Every rule below therefore has a check id enforced by ops/verify.sh, which exits non-zero. Rules that cannot be checked are marked advisory and are the known weak spots.

invariants.rule: MANIFEST.sha256 must verify against the working tree.

Every tracked file must appear in MANIFEST.sha256 except MANIFEST.sha256 itself and MANIFEST.sha256.ots (a manifest cannot contain the hash of its own proof). This implies a seal ORDER: write receipts, stamp them, THEN build the manifest, THEN stamp the manifest — so receipts and their proofs are covered.
invariants.broken_on: 2026-07-25 (7 tracked files absent, including the new v1/*)
invariants.found_by_building_the_checker: seal_fakir_v2.sh built the manifest before stamping, so the receipt's .ots landed outside it. Order corrected in ops/candor.sh.

invariants.rule: Every substantive commit must have a Candor receipt naming its gitCommit. Sealing commits (subject 'attest:*') are exempt — a seal attests the commit before it, so attesting the seal is infinite regress. History before protocol_begins_at predates Candor and is exempt by declaration, not by silence.

A receipt is in-toto Statement v1 with predicateType https://project-ilm.org/attestations/candor/v1 and predicate {action,reason,utc,host}. reason may be empty ONLY if none was recorded; it is never invented.

An existing .ots is never overwritten. Rotation is: copy manifest AND its .ots to attest/history/<UTC>-, then clear the root .ots so a fresh stamp can be made. No proof is destroyed because the old manifest stays paired with the proof that attests it.
Copyright line '© 1993–2026 Abhishek Choudhary. All rights reserved.' on every artifact. Affiliation is AyeAI only; never 'Independent Researcher', never a past employer.
invariants.known_exception: zistgah/poie carries © 2026 deliberately (Kaivalyik Immutabilis) — flagged, not corrected

invariants.rule: No invented metadata, dates, DOIs or proofs. A gap is reported, never filled.

process.rule: One Step Trick: the canonical script performs EVERY step itself — clone, apply, verify, seal, receipt, stamp, commit, push, Pages, mint, DOI record-back. Never hand back a checklist; even printing 'run this next' is donkey work.
violations_2026_07_25: answered three build asks with design documents instead of code
shipped a script that required him to already be inside a clone; it failed in ~/work/24jul
split sealing into a second script he had to remember to run

script_shape.clones_to: ./<repo> under $PWD — never climbs out of the executing folder
script_shape.gate: ONE typed assertion per run covering the whole run, never one per item
script_shape.gate_parsing: tolerant: 'PUSH fix', 'PUSH, fix', 'PUSH: fix', lower case, extra spaces. The strict form cost four attempts at the gate on 2026-07-25.
script_shape.gate_is_the_intent: the typed word + reason IS the Candor intent; the same function that pushes must also write the receipt and reseal, so the seal cannot be forgotten
script_shape.long_waits: announced — OTS calendar waits are silent for tens of seconds and echo keystrokes; unannounced this reads as breakage
script_shape.deliverable: apply_X.sh + X.tar.gz beside it, both e2e-rehearsed before he sees them

verification.rule: Verify by execution, never by assertion. Behavioural oracle over real extracted code, then a mutation suite proving the oracle bites.
verification.learned_2026_07_25: mutation testing exposed 4 oracle assertions that hardcoded geometry instead of parsing it from the artifact under test — they passed no matter what the file said. An oracle that does not read the artifact is not a test.

retrieval.rule: Before modifying anything, retrieve the actual live state. Never assume, never reinvent.
retrieval.cost_2026_07_25: wrote a design document for a multi-world vehicle system (launchTo/TRANSIT/embodimentOn) that already existed and shipped in v1.0; also worked from a v0.7 baseline when live was v1.0.
retrieval.fix: ops/resume.sh emits RESUME.md — live HEAD, version, chain status, feature census — so a fresh session reads one file instead of a dozen retrieval calls.

routing.claude: kernel correctness, deep audits, verification harnesses
routing.chatgpt_gemini: generation, normalisation, copy, documentation, and the push for doc-only work
routing.human_only: canon rulings, ontology definitions, tradition defaults, naming, icons and visual/creative work
routing.fable: reserved — final architecture, papers, patents, monetisation, legal safety. Nothing groundwork.
routing.never_ai: pushing and minting. The seeded script executes those under his typed assertion, on his machine.
